# Figures

## Manuscript figures (fig1–fig5) — generated by `tools/make_figures.py`

Since draft v5 (2026-08-06) **all five manuscript figures** are generated by
one script, `../tools/make_figures.py` (matplotlib, no browser dependency),
which writes PDF (vector, used by both LaTeX builds) and PNG (for review)
into this directory and copies the PDFs into `paper/` and `paper_springer/`:

- `fig1_fcdd_process` — the FCDD method as executed in this study: the
  build-once contract package (four beats + artefacts), the per-defect FCDD
  repair lane it constrains, and the ordinary arm's lane, both ending at the
  sealed acceptance gate. Replaces the earlier Mermaid render (below), which
  described the full skill including deployment beats this experiment never
  exercised and was hard to read at paper scale.
- `fig2_cost_per_defect` — paired cost per defect (numbers from
  `tools/analyse.py`).
- `fig3_dispersion` — (a) across-defect cost strips per arm, (b) the bug01
  replication with solution-strategy markers (numbers from
  `tools/analyse_predictability.py`).
- `fig4_quality` — the counterbalanced grading round: axis means and paired
  composite differences with the 95% CI. **Correction (v5):** the earlier
  fig4 plotted the *voided* first grading round (n = 4); this one plots the
  counterbalanced round the text quotes.
- `fig5_review_effort_vs_cost` — cell cost vs reviewer invocations, 13
  final-instrument cells, imputed cell hollow and excluded from the fit
  (corrected ANCOVA per `tools/analyse_predictability.py`).

Regenerate everything with:

```sh
python3 tools/make_figures.py
```

The v4-era generator that used to live here (`figures/make_figures.py`) is
superseded and removed; its fig3 carried the withdrawn dispersion framing and
its fig4 plotted the voided grading round.

## `fcdd_process` — the full skill diagram (kept for reference)

Source: `fcdd_process.mmd` (Mermaid). Rendered: `fcdd_process.png` /
`fcdd_process.svg`. Drawn **from**
`~/.claude/skills/formal-contract-dev/SKILL.md` — the complete method
including the shell/validate/ship/operate stages that case 01's experiment
did not exercise. No longer used by the manuscript (fig1 above replaced it),
but retained as documentation of the full lifecycle.

**It tracks the LIVE skill, so it goes stale silently.** Re-render it in the same
commit as any installed-skill change, the way `skills/README.md` requires for the
vendored copy. The title line carries the sync date; if it is older than the last
`skills/formal-contract-dev-current/` commit, the diagram is behind. Last sync
2026-08-29 added Beat 0.5, laws 13-14, the FCDD-T/FCDD-X variant naming, and the
spec-evolution residual — all of which had been live in the skill and absent here.

### Regenerating the Mermaid diagram

The Mermaid CLI needs a browser; the bundled download fails in this VM, so
point it at the system Chrome and disable the sandbox:

```sh
echo '{"args":["--no-sandbox","--disable-setuid-sandbox","--disable-dev-shm-usage"]}' > /tmp/pptr.json
PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/opt/google/chrome/chrome \
  npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i fcdd_process.mmd -o fcdd_process.svg \
  -b transparent -p /tmp/pptr.json
```

Known layout note: phases render bottom-to-top (① lowest) because the
lifecycle-closing edge (OPERATE → Beat 1) outranks layout hints.
